title: Digest extract
description: Body of an `evidence` artifact: verbatim spans of the artifacts a digest request names, selected by a rule in code before any Worker writes (the extractive digest provider, design/digests.md#extractive-first). Its envelope inputs are its sources, and its classification is at least theirs. The Worker reads `text` instead of the whole sources and cites a claim by an extract's id; the provider fills the claim's citation from `extracts`, and the quote check still reads the sources.

rule.description: The selection rule and its version: the same stored sources, rule, and bound give the same extract.

sources.description: The digested artifacts, in the request's order, each with how many spans of its text the rule weighed.

spans.description: Non-blank spans of its text the rule weighed: each line, or each part of a line longer than a quote may be.

truncated.description: Its text is longer than the rule reads: what follows was not weighed.

extracts.description: The spans kept, in the sources' order, numbered E1, E2, and so on.

offset.description: Where the quote starts in its source's text (the body's `text`, else its canonical JSON), in code points.

quote.description: Verbatim text of the source at `offset`: one line, or part of one, without surrounding whitespace.

signal.description: Why the rule kept it: a signal its text carries, or `context` (a source's first or last span, or room left).

text.description: What the Worker reads: the sources by number (S1, S2, …), then each extract with its id and its source's number.
